findings.text: blocking: the done_when requires the base run's failing ids logged beside the head run in this file, and git ls-tree at 253c17df56 lists no such path while the reviewed worktree holds none on disk, so the node's negative control is recorded only inside the run directory and one named done_when artifact never landed.

non-blocking: the autouse store_home fixture points RECKON_HOME and RECKON_RUN_STORE at tmp_path but no case asserts this workstation's real store and config home were left untouched afterwards, which the repository's test-isolation rule asks for because an isolated write is not proven by an isolated read.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 253c17df56 against parent 4d464485b8 commit by commit; the diff moves the run store under tmp_path, seeds the roster through ledger.write_members, and reads the hold, reap and retirement transitions from the store while keeping every aggregate assertion and adding stored["holds"] == [].
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a head gate as an all_debug job, a first-at-base run with its failing ids, a cause verdict per failure, an arm pair in inline JSON with 40-character revisions, a clean ruff on the changed paths, and the base run logged beside the head run in docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-the-ledger-writer-refuses-a-fold.html; the manifest records the head gate, the base run (3 failed, 7 passed, EXIT=1) and both arm JSONs, but that named fragment exists at neither head 253c17df56 nor its worktree, so one named item is unmet.
